title: Buyer Radar - service evaluation harness
note: Every case with provenance 'executed' is run against the service's own modules with local fixtures: no network call, no model call, no money. A case with provenance 'recorded' is not re-run; its verdict is read from a recorded evaluation result and the harness says which file it read.

cases.description: Two sightings whose phone numbers normalise to the same E.164 value are folded into one lead.
cases.expected: one lead, one duplicate merged

cases.description: Two sightings with no phone, the same normalised trading name and the same city are folded into one lead.
cases.expected: one lead, one duplicate merged

cases.description: The same trading name in two different cities stays two leads.
cases.expected: two leads, no duplicate merged

cases.description: A merged lead keeps the register's status and notes; a fetch never resets them.
cases.expected: status contacted and the existing note survive the merge

cases.description: Two notices published by one institution stay two requirements: a requirement is identified by its own notice.
cases.expected: two leads, no duplicate merged

cases.description: docs/scoring.md requirement worked example: closes in 4 days, quantity inside capacity, a phone and an email, a different city in a different state.
The digest prints REQUIREMENTS POSTED, then BUYERS TO APPROACH, then the mandi price block, whatever the scores say.
cases.expected: requirements before buyers before prices

cases.description: A register far larger than the WhatsApp cap still renders a digest within DIGEST.maxChars.
cases.expected: rendered text at most 1500 characters

cases.description: A requirement with no phone and no email is shown, and its contact line says so rather than showing anything callable.
cases.expected: the line reads 'contact not found yet' and carries no digits

cases.description: The mandi price block is the last thing before the reply footer.
cases.expected: the price block sits after both lead sections

cases.description: The price sheet carries one line per catalogue item, and every item with a mandi line shows its market and its arrival date.
cases.expected: every catalogue item present, each priced line carrying a market and a date

cases.description: A catalogue item Agmarknet carries no line for says 'no mandi quote today' rather than guessing a price.
cases.expected: 'no mandi quote today' for every unpriced item

cases.description: When the cap bites, the plan order sheds registrations first, then buyers one at a time, and a posted requirement last.
cases.expected: the last plans drop requirements only after registrations and buyers are already at zero

cases.description: Tie diversification reorders only inside an equal-score group and never breaks score order.
cases.expected: scores non-increasing after diversifyTies

cases.description: A plain directory row whose source already gave a segment, whose size cannot move the digest, and which is not a requirement missing a date.
cases.expected: needsModel enrich returns not needed

cases.description: The cache already holds an answer for this exact page and prompt version.
cases.expected: needsModel enrich returns not needed, reason names the cache

cases.description: A requirement carrying no closing date.
cases.expected: needsModel enrich returns needed

cases.description: Article text that never uses procurement wording cannot contain a posted requirement.
cases.expected: needsModel requirement returns not needed, reason 'no procurement wording'

cases.description: A notice using procurement wording whose quantity, closing date and contact the deterministic readers could not find.
cases.expected: needsModel requirement returns needed

cases.description: A publisher's article: it may state a requirement, but nothing on it names the buyer or the buyer's own site.
cases.expected: needsModel requirement returns needed even with deterministic reads present

cases.description: A second ask for the same input, model and prompt version is served from the cache.
cases.expected: one call for two asks; the second is a cache hit and costs nothing

cases.description: The day's spend is already at the cap before the ask.
cases.expected: no call, an llm.budget_exhausted receipt, and totals.budgetSkipped 1

cases.description: Plain text from the owner's own number is answered with the latest digest.
cases.expected: one reply sent to the owner, carrying the digest text

cases.description: An inbound message from any other number is recorded and never answered, and its text is not stored.
cases.expected: inbound recorded, no reply sent, stored text null

cases.description: An owner command of the form L<n> won updates that lead's status through the register.
cases.expected: status moves to won and a receipt hash is quoted back

cases.description: Meta redelivering a message id already acted on must not re-apply the command.
cases.expected: the second delivery is a duplicate: no reply, no status change

cases.description: A POST whose X-Hub-Signature-256 does not match the app secret.
cases.expected: HTTP 401 and a whatsapp.rejected receipt

cases.description: A POST with WA_APP_SECRET unset: nothing can be verified, so nothing is accepted.
cases.expected: HTTP 503

cases.description: A failed delivery status carrying Meta error 131047, the 24-hour re-engagement rule.
cases.expected: recorded as a delivery failure with the code, and surfaced as the last failure

cases.description: An owner-only tool called by an actor that is not the owner and not the pipeline.
cases.expected: refused, with a tool.refused receipt and no tool.call

cases.description: A site a model read off an article that resolves to a newspaper or a search engine is refused as the buyer's own site.
cases.expected: refused with a reason naming the host

cases.description: A plain http(s) host that is neither a publisher, a search engine nor a social page is accepted.
cases.expected: accepted, origin returned

cases.description: Phone normalisation never invents a country code: a run of digits that is not a complete Indian number is refused.
cases.expected: null for a 9-digit and an 11-digit run; +91 only where ten digits are actually present

cases.description: The e-procurement portal's own helpdesk address is not the buyer's contact.
cases.expected: the helpdesk address is dropped; the buyer's own address survives

cases.description: A date-shaped run of digits in a notice is not read as a phone number.
cases.expected: no phone found in a line of dates

cases.description: Every source states a licence, and the licence survives onto the persisted lead.
cases.expected: a non-empty licence on every source's configuration and on the lead built from it

cases.description: The evidence bundle hash is sha256 over schema, newline, count, newline, then each receipt's JSON and a newline.
cases.expected: the recomputed digest equals bundleHash()

cases.description: Receipt order is part of the hash.
cases.expected: swapping two receipts changes the hash

cases.description: tools/verify.mjs on a sealed bundle.
cases.expected: exit code 0 and VERIFIED on stdout

cases.description: tools/verify.mjs on the same bundle with one field changed.
cases.expected: exit code 1 and a hash mismatch reported

cases.description: Every receipt a run and the tool layer emit carries a role from the fixed set.
cases.expected: a role in scout, reader, verifier, desk, owner, auditor on every receipt

cases.description: A status set in one process is still there when the store is opened again.
cases.expected: the lead reads back as won after a reopen

cases.description: A NUL byte in text is stripped before it reaches Postgres.
cases.expected: no U+0000 anywhere in the written value

cases.description: A lone surrogate in text is stripped before it reaches Postgres.
cases.expected: no unpaired surrogate left; a valid pair survives

cases.description: The day's model spend is held in the store, so a restart resumes the same day's total instead of handing the cap back.
cases.expected: the second budget reads the first's spend and refuses the next call

cases.description: A cached model answer written in one process is served in the next.
cases.expected: the answer comes back as a cache hit with no call
